what_happened: A woman who had undergone sterilization under the former Eugenic Protection Law filed a State Redress Act damages action against the national government.
result_or_next_step: The filing made the contemporary judicial remedy pathway formally observable; the litigation proceeded through appeals.

what_happened: The Diet enacted the 2019 lump-sum payment law for people who had undergone eugenic surgery under the former law.
result_or_next_step: Most provisions took effect the same day, creating a national 3.2 million yen lump-sum payment pathway.

institution: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare and prefectural governments
what_happened: The Ministry issued implementation instructions for claims, ministerial recognition, prefectural receipt, and payment under the 2019 law.
result_or_next_step: The statutory lump-sum remedy entered administrative operation through national and prefectural procedures.

institution: Supreme Court of Japan, Grand Bench
what_happened: The Grand Bench held the former law's eugenic-surgery provisions unconstitutional and the related legislative conduct unlawful under the State Redress Act.
result_or_next_step: The Court rejected the government's exclusion-period defense in the Sendai case and recognized a basis for state liability, followed by executive and legislative responses.

institution: Prime Minister of Japan and Government of Japan
what_happened: The Prime Minister met plaintiffs and affected people, apologized on behalf of the government, and stated directions for resolving pending litigation and creating a new compensation framework.
result_or_next_step: The government began work on settlements and a broader compensation response with the cross-party Diet group.

what_happened: The Diet unanimously passed a new compensation law whose preamble acknowledged responsibility in light of the 2024 Supreme Court judgments.
result_or_next_step: The law was promulgated on 2024-10-17 and scheduled to take effect on 2025-01-17, creating compensation and revised lump-sum pathways.

institution: Children and Families Agency, prefectural governments, and recognition commission
what_happened: The 2024 compensation law took effect and official claim reception began through prefectural windows under national recognition and payment procedures.
result_or_next_step: Claims and recognitions continue; official reporting through 2026-04 recorded 2,616 claims and 1,848 recognitions.
